actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on Public Lands, Forests, and Mining. Hearings held.

Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 233.

subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the municipal government and local population of The Dalles, Oregon.
dimensions.evidence: conveyance of approximately 150 acres of National Forest System land... from the Forest Service to the City of The Dalles, Oregon.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers ownership of a specific 150-acre parcel of federal land to local control for municipal water and infrastructure needs.
dimensions.evidence: used by the City for public purposes, including for municipal water supply and use and related infrastructure needs or expansions.

dimensions.assessment: Requires the city to pay all administrative and survey costs associated with the conveyance.
dimensions.evidence: the City shall pay all costs associated with the conveyance, including the cost of a survey

dimensions.assessment: Localised land conveyance measure affecting a single designated federal property parcel.
dimensions.evidence: convey certain Federal land to the City of The Dalles, Oregon.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent land transfer with ongoing conditions and a reversion clause.
dimensions.evidence: all right, title, and interest in and to the land shall revert to the United States.

importance_detail.rationale: Directs the conveyance of approximately 150 acres of National Forest System land to the City of The Dalles, Oregon, for municipal use under specific reversion conditions.
